work.summary: First solo pictorial by Korean creator 정현 (JUNGHYUN). Contemporary launch coverage announced an Interpark preorder and a 2022-11-30 release. A secondary-market product page corroborates that sealed print copies existed and reports Young and Beautiful versions with inserts; no ISBN, page count, publisher imprint, or exact variant specifications were independently verified. Cover omitted because exact-image reuse permission is unconfirmed.

edition.contentSummary: A printed first photo book. GlobalEpic's 2022-10-27 launch coverage announced preorder through Interpark and states a 2022-11-30 release. ThePower's 2022-11-07 story describes creator 정현's solo pictorial and its preorder response. A Bunjang Global secondary listing describes sealed print copies with folded poster and other inserts and mentions Young/Beautiful variants; those are not treated as verified edition metadata or current availability. ISBN, page count, and publisher imprint were not confirmed. Cover omitted because exact-image reuse permission is unconfirmed.
